2607.13763.title: MxGPS: Multiplex Graph Transformers for a Power Grid Foundation Model
2607.13763.paper_summary: Single-task fine-tuning of graph neural networks (GNNs) for power grid problems exhibits a systematic failure mode: models that achieve the lowest in-distribution error degrade the most under topology shift. We term this topology overfitting: the tendency of task-specific gradient signals to encode relational structure particular to the training topologies rather than the underlying physics, causing models to fail on unseen grids despite strong in-distribution performance. To expose and address this failure mode, we introduce MxGPS (Multiplex GPS), a multiplex graph transformer that runs K task-specialised GPS branches over a shared node encoder, jointly trained on Static State Estimation (SSE) and AC Power Flow (PF) via a self-supervised pre-training and multi-task fine-tuning protocol, with a cross-branch attention module evaluated in ablation. The joint SSE+PF objective forces the shared encoder to simultaneously satisfy complementary gradient signals, preventing it from overfitting to topology-specific relational structure. Under a 3-fold sliding-window cross-validation spanning four unseen topologies (14-, 24-, 162-, and 300-bus), MxGPS attains 0% boundary violation rate (BVR) on all four zero-shot Power Flow topologies. Critically, models with substantially lower in-distribution PF error degrade by 190% to 1400% under topology shift, whereas MxGPS degrades by only 39%, an inversion that directly implicates topology overfitting as the failure mechanism rather than insufficient model capacity. With only 1.6M parameters (12x fewer than the GridFM reference baseline), MxGPS demonstrates that multi-task joint training is a principled and parameter-efficient mechanism for topology-agnostic generalisation in power grid foundation models.
2607.13763.paper_summary_zh: 單任務微調圖神經網絡（GNNs）以解決電力網絡問題顯示出一種系統性的失效模式：在分佈內誤差最低的模型在拓撲變化下退化最嚴重。我們稱之為拓撲過擬合：任務特定的梯度信號傾向於編碼特定於訓練拓撲的關係結構，而非潛在的物理原理，導致模型在未見過的電網上失效，儘管在分佈內表現強勁。為了揭示並解決這一失效模式，我們介紹了MxGPS（Multiplex GPS），這是一種多路圖Transformer，運行K個任務專用的GPS分支，通過共享的節點編碼器進行聯合訓練，並通過自我監督的預訓練和多任務微調協議，針對靜態狀態估計（SSE）和交流功率流（PF）進行訓練，並在消融實驗中評估跨分支注意力模塊。聯合的SSE+PF目標強迫共享編碼器同時滿足互補的梯度信號，防止其過擬合於特定於拓撲的關係結構。在跨越四個未見拓撲（14、24、162和300總線）的三折滑動窗口交叉驗證下，MxGPS在所有四個零樣本功率流拓撲上達到0%的邊界違規率（BVR）。關鍵是，具有顯著較低的分佈內PF誤差的模型在拓撲變化下退化了190%至1400%，而MxGPS僅退化39%，這一反轉直接表明拓撲過擬合是失效機制，而非模型容量不足。MxGPS僅有1.6M參數（比GridFM參考基線少12倍），展示了多任務聯合訓練是一種原則性且參數高效的機制，能夠實現電力網絡基礎模型的拓撲無關泛化。
